free_text.text: MSE-optimal bandwidth from rdbwselect
Fixed 1-meter window for alternative specs
Geographic boundary RD. Main table via rdrobust (Table 3 panels A-D, 1853-1936). Fuzzy RD with death_ind (Appendix B2). Conley spatial SE for balance. Custom rd plotting via local polynomial.
Mixed Stata-Python pipeline for housing market structural estimation
Running variable pc91_pca_tot_p from 1991 census population
Cluster ID variables: gp_code_jj11_num (Joshi-Johnson 1995 delimitation), gp_code_lgd21_num (LGD 2021 delimitation)
Analysis datasets organized under $analysis_data/ by topic: villagedirectory/, amenities/, financial/, nregs/, mission_antyodaya/, gp_elections/, gp_development_plan/

Main design uses rdrobust-based RDD with sharp cutoff at 1000 village population. MultiPanelTabRD is a custom wrapper that calls rdrobust internally. Tables 1-6 are main results; additional appendix specs omitted due to budget constraints.
Two independent running variables: SABER 11 score and SISBEN index
Sharp discontinuity at each cutoff (cutoff=0)
First stage: beneficiary_spp (receipt of Ser Pilo Paga scholarship)
Bandwidth selection: data-driven (rdrobust default)
Kernel: triangular (rdrobust default)
Bandwidth stored in global macro after rdrobust call (${bw_r}, ${br_r}) for reuse in heterogeneous subgroup analysis to ensure consistency
Sampling conditions stored as global macros: ${cond_saber11} = 'eligible_sisben==1', ${cond_sisben} = 'eligible_saber11==1'
matrix ry2014 stores rdrobust results for table/figure production
keep if icfes_per==20142: sample cohort with ICFES exam date 2014/2
eligible_sisben==1 condition for SABER 11 running variable analysis
eligible_saber11==1 condition for SISBEN running variable analysis
Data loading source: ${data}/data_RD and ${data2}/PILA_cuatrimestral datasets not publicly available in code

Entry point: Master.do calls 2 input scripts (3_Results_years_PILA.do, 4_value_added_model.do) then 16 figure/table scripts. Main estimation conducted through rdrobust command (37 hits) with two running variables (running_saber11, running_sisben). Identified 3 specification families: reduced-form RD, fuzzy RD with beneficiary_spp instrument, and value-added model with reghdfe.
